entries.german:
Ulrich Wosner, Pfarrer von Friedberg, vermacht seine beweglichen und unbeweglichen Güter dem Stift Schlägl und stiftet mit zehn Pfund Wiener Pfennigen im Kloster einen Jahresgottesdienst am Fest der hl. Katharina mit einer Pitanz für die Brüder.

"Ego, Vlricus dictus Wosnerius(1), humilis rector ecclesie in Fridburch(2), omnibus presencia inspecturis, cupio fore notum, quod considerans luminosam ac laudabilem conuersacionem dominorum meorum in Plaga(3) sancte Marie, volens michi facere remedium singulare, ipsis et ecclesie eorum post mortem meam, eciam si forte, quod absit, intestatus decessero, lego et dono exnunc omnia bona mea, que in Fridburgensi ecclesia conquisiero seu illic de propriis apportauero, ita ut me decedente non solum vniuersa bona tam mobilia quam inmobilia, in ipsa dote inventa, verum eciam per totam parrochiam nec non circumquaque infra nemus tam in debitis quam in repositis quecumque fuerint indagata, ad ipsos ac ipsorum ecclesiam libere et sine infestacione omnium amicorum meorum sev aliorum quorumlibet deuoluantur, sub condicione et forma inferius annotata, videlicet ut me tradito debite et honorifice vbicumque elegero ecclesiastice sepulture, et quibuslibet meis debitis persolutis per ipsos aut successores eorum in mediate pro reuerencia festiuitatis mee gloriose videlicet Katherine(4) virginis, in summa decem librarum Wyennensium, certum predium comparetur: de cuius prouentibus in nocte(5) et in mane eiusdem festi fiat ibidem fratribus sev conuentui tantummodo solacium et pietancia(6) in communi: qui et festum huiusmodi cum propria hystoria et processione(7) sollempni perpetuis temporibus celebrabunt. Insuper libros ad diuinum cultum spectantes necessarios Fridburgensi ecclesie infra meos repertos, ipsi sine alienacione qualibet ibidem tenentur relinquere: reliquos ipsis in solacium, michique in memoriale perpetuum ad prelibatam Plagensem ecclesiam deportabunt(8). Ammodo in ipsorum consciencias me et mea fiducialius recommittens, vt de residuis rebus inuentis faciant et ordinent secundum quod saluti mee anime crediderint expedire. Jn cuius rei testimonium presens instrumentum ipsis dedi, sigilli domini de Rosenberch(9) nec non proprij robore conmunitum. Datum anno Domini Mo. CCCo. quinto, jn natiuitate virginis gloriose. Preterea adicio eciam et promitto, quod ecclesia in Fridburch in diuino cultu et officio non debet negligi temporibus uite mee, sed pocius debeo et promitto plenius prouidere, presencium testimonio litterarum."

Siegel: Siegel an Pergamentbändchen hängend: Pfarrer Ulrich Wosner. Gelbes Wachs, oval, 40 x 28 mm. Umschrift: "S VLRICI PLEBANI D FRIDBURCH." Wappen: Nach rechts schreitender Mann, mit Stab über der Schulter, daran die abgezogene Haut wie eine Fahne (hl. Kirchenpatron Bartholomäus).
entries.english:
Ulrich Wosner, parish priest of Friedberg, bequeaths his movable and immovable goods to Schlägl Monastery and endows an annual service there on the feast of St. Catherine, with a pitance for the brothers, using ten pounds of Viennese pennies.

I, Ulrich called Wosner, humble rector of the church at Friedberg, wish all who see this document to know that, considering the exemplary and praiseworthy way of life of my lords at St. Mary's in Schlägl and wishing to provide a special remedy for myself, I bequeath and give now to them and their church, after my death, even if I should happen, God forbid, to die intestate, all my goods that I have acquired at the church of Friedberg or brought there from my own possessions. Upon my death, not only all movable and immovable goods found in the endowment itself, but also whatever is found throughout the parish and all around within the forest, whether owed to me or held in storage, shall pass freely to them and their church without interference from any of my friends or anyone else, subject to the following conditions.

After I have been duly and honorably given ecclesiastical burial wherever I choose, and all my debts have been paid, they or their successors shall immediately purchase a particular estate for ten pounds of Viennese pennies in honor of the feast of my glorious virgin St. Catherine. From its revenues, the brothers or convent alone shall receive refreshment and a communal pitance there on the eve and morning of that feast. They shall celebrate the feast forever with its proper office and a solemn procession. Further, they are obliged to leave at Friedberg, without alienating them, the books found among mine that are needed for divine worship at that church; they shall take the others to the church at Schlägl for their comfort and as a perpetual memorial of me. Henceforth I entrust myself and my possessions more confidently to their consciences, so that they may deal with and dispose of the remaining goods as they believe expedient for the salvation of my soul.

In witness, I have given them this instrument, strengthened with the seals of the lord von Rosenberg and myself. Given in the year of the Lord 1305, on the Nativity of the glorious Virgin. I further add and promise that divine worship and service at the church in Friedberg shall not be neglected during my lifetime, but that I must and promise to provide for them more fully, as this letter attests.

Seal: Hanging from a parchment strip, the seal of parish priest Ulrich Wosner, in yellow wax, oval, 40 by 28 mm. Inscription: “S VLRICI PLEBANI D FRIDBURCH.” Arms: a man walking to the right, with a staff over his shoulder and a flayed skin hanging from it like a flag (the church's patron saint Bartholomew).
